Name: Em's Sprinklers (incl. Pressure Nozzle and Enricher)
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
Four options for the Sprinkler, Quality Sprinkler and Iridium Sprinkler
Additionally, you can change them into frogs.
Including the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Pressure_Nozzle]Pressure Nozzle[/url]﻿ and [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Enricher]Enricher[/url]
Available for Content Patcher, ﻿compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/J75PMvSF/Seasonal_Sprinkler.gif[/img][/url]

The sprinklers have softer colours, and their metal shines a bit more
There is a Nozzle and Enricher to match the metal for each sprinkler, or you can mismatch them 
You can choose "[color=#e69138]Em's seasonal sprinklers[/color]" which are covered i[color=#f4f4f4]n snow in winter or hidden between leaves in fall[/color]
Alternatively, "[color=#e69138]Em's sprinklers[/color]" offers all options but without any seasonal details

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/44QBsqjS/Frog_Sprinkler.gif[/img]

These (seasonal) frogs make sure they water your flowers and crops each morning, just like ﻿sprinklers do
There are two types of frog friends to help them out with their task
The [color=#e69138]green[/color] frog, which is an Enricher. Give him some fertiliser, and he helps spread it among your crops
The [color=#e69138]brown[/color] frog, which is a Pressure Nozzle. He makes sure the water reaches just a little further

When placed, they sit on their friend's back. When you hit them with a tool, they jump off again
Note that an original Enricher or Nozzle won't look good on a [i]frog[/i] sprinkler
So when choosing a frog sprinkler, ensure the Enricher or Nozzle is also a frog type

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Sprinklers" or "Em's Seasonal Sprinklers"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

To choose a different sprinkler type:
Open the [i]config.json[/i] file in the Sprinkler mod folder
Replace the "[color=#e69138]Type[/color]" with the option you like
You can find all the options in the [i]Reference.png[/i]
Save and close the folder again, and you're all set!
﻿Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MGb2cDyd/Patchnotes.png[/img]

[i]Update 1.1 New seasonal details, spritework changes, added config options
Update 1.2 Three new metal options[/i]
